err_no_store: The workspace board needs a database that supports it
err_readonly: A read-only device can’t change the workspace board
err_bad_request: A valid request and revision are required
err_already_bound: This directory already has a card. Check the existing or archived cards
err_offline: The computer is offline. Bind the workspace once it reconnects
err_list_failed: Couldn’t list workspaces. Check the node version: {error}
err_changed: The workspace changed. Refresh and choose again
err_no_directory: This workspace has no code directory to confirm. Bind a directory directly
err_resolve_failed: Couldn’t verify the directory. Check the path and node version: {error}
err_resolve_empty: Verifying the directory returned no usable workspace
err_snapshot_read: Couldn’t read the workspace history snapshot
err_activity_unavailable: Activity history is not available on this manager. Update it to enable history.
err_activity_gone: This activity is no longer available. Refresh the history.
